Not counted as a rendering finding (the blind answer derived the hop from the purchase hub's sentence); route to the instantiate loop if the source is meant to leave that hop to be worked out.
- S1 of policy_kb/0.md (sale-date field on the air-path line) and S2 (non-refundable / device-price parameter descriptions) concern task 0's policies only.
